# BRD: Loan Onboarding Portal
As a loan officer I need... Requirements SF-1..SF-6. Financial services compliance (SOX §404). Experience Cloud customer portal. Integrations: MuleSoft, DocuSign, Plaid, Snowflake, REST API. Data migration of legacy data via ETL. Phase 1 MVP then Phase 2.

## Requirements Register
SF-1 The system shall route new intake cases to the regional queue by territory.
SF-2 Agents must work all intake channels from a unified Lightning console.
SF-3 The solution shall encrypt sensitive member data at rest and in transit.
US-4 As a supervisor I need real-time dashboards of intake SLA compliance.
NFR-5 The platform should sustain 200 concurrent agents at peak.
